title: Wildly Shattering Tunisian Fish Tagine
description: A savory and adventurous Tunisian dish featuring fish sauce and lacto-vegetarian-friendly ingredients, with a shattering texture from the mantecare-emulsify method. This recipe combines the flavors of the Mediterranean with a unique cooking technique.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the fish sauce, canned tomatoes, vegetable broth, honey, dried parsley, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Use the mantecare-emulsify method to shatter the sauce and create a thick and creamy texture.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional parsley and crusty bread on the side.
Let the tagine rest for 10 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
